card.name: Cycle counts and numbers in chemo dosing
card.fires_on: Numbers, spaces and small words just before a count of treatment cycles or inside dose and section numbers in oncology dosing text. Often the space after 'for' before a number of cycles.

modes.label: Before cycle count
modes.description: The space or 'for' right before a number of chemotherapy cycles.
modes.example: This regimen is administered every 3 weeks for<< >>3 cycles.

modes.label: Digits in doses and sections
modes.description: A digit inside a dose figure or a section number reference in oncology labels.

modes.label: Dose table ranges
modes.description: The space inside a range of values in a dose adjustment table.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like 'cycles' and cycle-related terms.
card.plain: It lights up where a chemo label is about to say how many cycles to give.
